comparison.objective: Tip a full-width pan so aggregate feeds all 12 riffle-splitter chutes evenly.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pan support, level-lip control, controlled granular pouring, and distribution regulation.
comparison.success_condition: All 12 chutes receive an even feed. Numeric evenness, spill, and residual-material thresholds are not stated.
comparison.reason: Granular-flow distribution tests coordinated pouring, whereas the candidate tests precise mandrel alignment, controlled impact fracture, and containment of four discrete fragments.
